Chapter III: Provisions Applicable to Wholesale Packages

allRules.title: Short title, extent and commencement
allRules.summary: Establishes title as Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and defines its nationwide legal jurisdiction across India.

allRules.title: Definitions
allRules.summary: Defines statutory terms including combination package, group package, multi-piece package, institutional consumer, industrial consumer, principal display panel (PDP), retail dealer, retail package, retail sale price (MRP), and unit sale price (USP).

allRules.title: Applicability of Chapter II
allRules.summary: Specifies Chapter II applies to all packages intended for retail sale. Exempts packages >25kg or >25L (excl. cement/fertilizer up to 50kg) and sales to industrial/institutional consumers.

allRules.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities in packaged form
allRules.summary: Prohibits pre-packing, distribution, sale, or delivery of any commodity in packaged form unless it complies with all declarations and packaging standards of these rules.

allRules.title: Specific commodities to be packed and sold in standard packages
allRules.summary: Mandates that commodities specified in the Second Schedule (baby food, tea, coffee, edible oil, biscuits, cereals, etc.) must be packed only in prescribed rationalized standard weight/volume packages.

allRules.title: Declarations to be made on every package
allRules.summary: Mandates 10 core declarations: (1)(a) Manufacturer/Packer/Importer details with PIN, (1)(aa) Country of origin for imports, (1)(b) Generic name, (1)(c) Net quantity, (1)(d) Month/year of manufacture, (1)(da) Expiry/Best-before, (1)(e) MRP inclusive of taxes, (1)(f) Dimensions where relevant, (2) Consumer grievance details (phone & email), (10) E-commerce digital declarations, (11) Unit Sale Price (USP).
keySubrules: Rule 6(1)(a) - Name and complete address of manufacturer/packer/importer
Rule 6(1)(aa) - Country of origin for imported goods
Rule 6(1)(b) - Common or generic name of commodity
Rule 6(1)(c) - Net quantity in standard SI units
Rule 6(1)(da) - Best before / use by date for perishables
Rule 6(1)(e) - Maximum Retail Price (MRP) 'inclusive of all taxes'
Rule 6(1)(f) - Dimensions of commodities where size is relevant
Rule 6(2) - Consumer care contact (name/office, phone, email, address)
Rule 6(10) - E-commerce mandatory digital listing declarations
Rule 6(11) - Unit Sale Price (USP) per g/kg, ml/L, cm/m, or per number

allRules.title: Principal Display Panel (PDP) – its area, size and letter height
allRules.summary: Establishes Table-I specifications for minimum permissible font height of numerals and letters based on the total surface area of the Principal Display Panel (PDP).

allRules.title: Declaration where to appear
allRules.summary: Requires all mandatory declarations to be grouped together and clearly visible on the Principal Display Panel without opening or damaging the container.

allRules.title: Manner in which declaration shall be made
allRules.summary: Mandates high visual contrast against background, prominent and legible typography, clear layout, and declaration in Hindi (Devanagari script) or English.

allRules.title: Declaration of name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer
allRules.summary: Regulates exact postal address declaration requirements, corporate office disclosures, contract packaging declarations, and electronic products QR code address options.

allRules.title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
allRules.summary: Requires net quantity to express the pure net weight, measure or volume of the commodity excluding all wrapper and packaging materials (tare weight exclusion).

allRules.title: Manner of declaration of quantity
allRules.summary: Specifies placement of units, decimal fraction notations, and prohibitions on misleading fraction representations in net weight/volume expressions.

allRules.title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
allRules.summary: Mandates SI metric units (g, kg, ml, l, m, cm, mm, number, piece, pair, set). Strictly prohibits qualifying words such as 'approx', 'minimum', 'not less than', 'average', or 'about'.

allRules.title: Declarations on packages containing commodities of varying size and dimension
allRules.summary: Governs labeling of bedsheets, sarees, curtains, towels, wires, ropes, paper sheets, tiles, and containers specifying width, length, and usable dimensions.

allRules.title: Declaration of quantity in relation to commodities packed in numbers
allRules.summary: Specifies rules for commodities sold by numerical count (tablets, capsules, pens, matchsticks, bandages, napkins, eggs).

allRules.title: Declarations on combination, group and multi-piece packages
allRules.summary: Mandates outer carton disclosures showing individual item names, net quantity of each component, total number of units, and total combined MRP inclusive of taxes.

allRules.title: Qualifications / non-misleading statements in relation to units of measurement
allRules.summary: Prohibits deceptive qualifiers modifying units of measure (e.g. 'jumbo litre', 'giant kilogram', 'commercial metre', 'super gram').

allRules.title: Provisions relating to retail sale and actions by retail dealers
allRules.summary: Strictly prohibits selling at a price higher than declared MRP, smudging, altering, overwriting, stickering higher price, or concealing the declared retail price.

allRules.title: Inspection of quantity in pre-packed commodities
allRules.summary: Authorizes Legal Metrology Officers to inspect premises, draw samples, weigh packages, and verify net quantity at factory, warehouse, and retail points.

allRules.title: Action to be taken on determination of error in quantity
allRules.summary: Defines Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) tolerances under the First Schedule and prescribes statutory action when individual or batch error exceeds limits.

allRules.title: Action to be taken on determination of non-standard packages
allRules.summary: Grants power to seize, confiscate, or initiate prosecution for packages not conforming to standardized sizes under Schedule II.

allRules.title: Manner of selection of samples for testing
allRules.summary: Prescribes statistical sampling plans and sample size tables relative to batch/lot size for official net quantity verification.

allRules.title: Checking of quantity of samples and compliance assessment
allRules.summary: Standardizes laboratory testing and measurement procedures for determination of average net quantity and individual package defects.

allRules.title: Checking of quantity in retail packages
allRules.summary: Prescribes on-site point-of-sale test weighing and verification protocols for consumer retail packages.

allRules.title: Action by Director, Controller or Legal Metrology Officer in cases of short delivery / defective packages
allRules.summary: Empowers authorities to issue show-cause notices, compound offences, or file court complaints for short-weight and misleading packages.

allRules.title: Exemptions in respect of certain packages
allRules.summary: Exempts: (a) packages <=10g or <=10ml (except tobacco), (b) fast food packed by hotels/restaurants, (c) DPCO scheduled drug formulations (excl. medical devices), (d) loose garments/hosiery, (e) loose e-commerce sales, (f) handloom raw yarn coils.

allRules.title: Declarations on wholesale packages
allRules.summary: Requires wholesale containers to declare: (a) Name & address of manufacturer/packer, (b) Generic name, (c) Total net quantity or number of retail packages inside, (d) Wholesale Maximum Retail Price.

allRules.title: Special provisions relating to wholesale packages
allRules.summary: Defines packaging and labeling exceptions for wholesale bulk containers transported directly to industrial or processing facilities.

allRules.title: Provisions relating to export of packaged commodities
allRules.summary: Exempts packages manufactured exclusively for export from domestic label formats, allowing compliance with destination country standards.

allRules.title: Provisions relating to import of packaged commodities
allRules.summary: Mandates that imported packaged goods must bear all mandatory Indian declarations (importer name, address, origin, MRP in INR, Net Qty in SI units) prior to customs clearance.

allRules.title: Mandatory registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
allRules.summary: Requires all pre-packers, manufacturers, and importers to register their business premises and commodity categories with Central Director or State Controller of Legal Metrology within 90 days.

allRules.title: Penalty for contravention of rules
allRules.summary: Prescribes compounding fines under Section 36 of Legal Metrology Act: up to ₹25,000 for 1st offence, ₹50,000 for 2nd offence, and up to ₹1,00,000 / imprisonment for subsequent offences.

allRules.title: Power to exempt
allRules.summary: Vests authority in the Central Government to grant general or special exemptions to specific industries or commodities in public interest.

allRules.title: Repeal and savings
allRules.summary: Repeals the Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977 while preserving rights, liabilities, and prior actions initiated thereunder.

mandatoryFields.name: Name & complete address of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
mandatoryFields.notes: For imported goods packed in India, packer/importer's Indian address is also mandatory on PDP. Electronic products may use QR code for address.

mandatoryFields.name: Common or generic name of commodity
Net Quantity
mandatoryFields.notes: Must use SI units only. 'N or U' symbol requirement was removed by 2022 amendment; instead a plain word (number/unit/piece/pair/set) is required. Words like 'minimum', 'about', 'approximately' are prohibited.

mandatoryFields.name: Month & Year of Manufacture
exemptions: warrantied spare parts/accessories not sold to end customer

mandatoryFields.name: Best Before / Use By Date
mandatoryFields.condition: Only required if commodity may become unfit for human consumption over time.
exemptions: governed by another specific law (e.g. FSSAI)

mandatoryFields.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
acceptedFormats: Maximum or Max. retail price Rs./₹ xx.xx (inclusive of all taxes)
MRP Rs./₹ xx.xx incl. of all taxes
mandatoryFields.notes: Must be in Indian currency. Rounding-off provisos were later omitted (now no mandatory rounding rule).

mandatoryFields.name: Unit Sale Price (USP)
notRequiredIf: retail sale price equals unit sale price

formula.byWeight: per gram if net qty < 1kg, else per kg
formula.byLength: per cm if net length < 1m, else per metre
formula.byVolume: per ml if net volume < 1L, else per litre

mandatoryFields.name: Dimensions (where size is relevant)
mandatoryFields.condition: Applies to bed-sheets, towels, sarees, bags/boxes/containers, etc.

ecommerce.requirement: All mandatory declarations except month/year of manufacture must be shown on the digital listing.
ecommerce.marketplaceSafeHarbor: Marketplace e-commerce entities are not liable for declaration accuracy if acting as a pure intermediary under IT Act due-diligence conditions.

thread sold in coil to handloom weavers

requiresDisclosure: size in metric or S/M/L notation

exemptions_full_rule26.condition: loose commodities ordered via e-commerce where buyer knows type/quantity

cement, fertilizer, agricultural produce sold in bags above 50kg
